name: Theory of Fabric Structure
description: Engineering approach to fabric formation; fibre, yarn and fabric structure- property relationships; crimp interchange in woven fabric; elastica model for fabric parameters and crimp balance; concept of fabric relaxation and set; practical application of geometrical and elastica models; uniaxial and biaxial tensile deformation of woven fabric; bending deformation of woven fabric. Bending behaviour of set and unset fabrics; bending in bias direction; shear and drape properties of woven fabric; buckling and compressional behaviour of woven fabrics; mathematical models and their application in the study of tensile, bending, shear, compressional, and buckling deformation of woven fabrics; structure-property relationship of knitted, nonwoven, and braided fabrics.
